newsitem.title: SLOVAKIA: Slovak FinMin sees H1 budget gap near SKK 10 bln.
newsitem.headline: Slovak FinMin sees H1 budget gap near SKK 10 bln.

text.p: The Slovak Finance Ministry said on Friday it expected the state budget deficit for the first half of 1997 to total some 10 billion crowns, compared to a 6.13 billion crown shortfall for the same period in 1996.
"According to preliminary forecasts, we estimate the (budget) deficit to be around 10 billion crowns by the end of June," ministry spokesman Jozef Mach told Reuters.
The budget deficit totalled 4.692 billion crowns for the first four months of this year, up from a 3.45 billion shortfall in the first quarter.
The full year 1997 state budget deficit is planned at 36.9 bilion crowns. Revenues are targetted at 171.1 billion crowns, while budget expenditures are expected to total 208.8 billion crowns.
The ministry is refinancing budget deficits by issuing state securities on the domestic market, using treasury bills with various maturities and one-year state bonds.
